evidence_class: board raw-register read while protected panel is active
command: modprobe i2c-dev; i2cset -y 0 0x3b 0xff 0x80; i2cset -y 0 0x3b 0xee 0x01; i2cget -y 0 0x3b 0x02; i2cset -y 0 0x3b 0xff 0x82; i2cget -y 0 0x3b 0x5e
interpretation: Neither bit 2 nor bit 0 is set, so the current driver interprets this value as disconnected.
limits: The operator reported plugging in after the initial sample; no glass or touch observation is inferred from raw HPD.
The I2C character-device module was loaded; no reset or interrupt GPIO was changed.
This is not a new monitor-driver boot or a live display-switch proof.
